{{Short description|Logical fallacy}}

'''Subverted support''' is a [[logical fallacy]] of explanation which attempts to explain something that does not happen.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Bennett|first=Bo|title=Subverted Support|url=https://www.logicallyfallacious.com/logicalfallacies/Subverted-Support|access-date=2022-02-10|website=Logically Fallacious|language=en}}</ref>

==Logical form==
''X'' happens because of ''Y'' (when ''X'' does not actually happen or exist)

==Exception==
The fallacy is true if a preceding statement claims that whatever follows is true.
